Sinan Rahman

Video editor / filmmaker
Learn. Resolve. Create.

I cut reels, short films and wedding stories, mostly in Kerala and mostly with friends who say yes to one more take. Every project starts in the timeline: rhythm first, colour second, titles last.

I edit in DaVinci Resolve and CapCut, and I've run a hands-on video editing workshop at MACE for Technova and ISTE.
